name: SIDESTEP
rules: Move one friendly piece 1 square horizontally or vertically to an empty square.
artSubject: wind bending a cluster of bamboo stems sideways, one fallen leaf sweeping to the side

name: DASH
rules: Move one friendly piece exactly 2 squares horizontally or vertically. Both squares must be empty.
artSubject: a powerful rushing stream cutting a straight path between dark river stones, strong horizontal ink motion

name: BLINK
rules: Teleport one friendly piece to an empty square within distance 3. Ignore pieces between.
artSubject: two empty stone rings separated by mist, black ink dissolving at one and gathering at the other

name: EXCHANGE
rules: Swap two friendly pieces within distance 3 of each other.
artSubject: two smooth black and ivory river stones exchanging places along two interlocking ink arcs

name: ADVANCE
rules: Move two different friendly pieces 1 square each toward the enemy starting edge. Both destinations must be empty.
artSubject: two parallel brushstroke waves moving forward together, two small stones carried along their crests

name: RECALL
rules: Teleport one friendly piece to any empty square on your starting row.
artSubject: a winding ribbon of mist returning to an empty mountain temple gate, no people

name: STRIKE
rules: Choose a friendly piece. Eliminate 1 enemy horizontally or vertically adjacent to it. Your piece stays still.
artSubject: one sharp sword blade cutting a single diagonal ink slash through falling leaves, no wielder

name: PIERCE
rules: Choose a friendly piece. Eliminate an enemy exactly 2 squares away horizontally or vertically. The square between must be empty.
artSubject: a single long spear passing through a narrow gap in bamboo, no wielder

name: SURROUND
rules: Eliminate 1 enemy horizontally or vertically adjacent to at least two friendly pieces.
artSubject: two pale stones enclosing one dark stone on a minimalist sandy surface, sweeping encircling ink

name: SWEEP
rules: Choose a friendly piece. Eliminate up to 2 enemies horizontally or vertically adjacent to it.
artSubject: a broad circular crescent of wind scattering two dry leaves, dynamic black ink arc

name: SHOVE
rules: Choose a friendly piece. Push an adjacent enemy 1 square directly away. The destination must be empty and on the board.
artSubject: a gust of wind forcefully pushing a dark river stone away from a pale one, symbolic kinetic ink

name: PULL
rules: Choose a friendly piece. Pull an enemy exactly 2 squares away horizontally or vertically into the empty square between.
artSubject: a curved fishing hook and flowing line drawing a dark stone toward a pale stone, no hands

name: VAULT
rules: Move one friendly piece exactly 2 squares horizontally or vertically to an empty square. You may jump over a piece.
artSubject: a smooth skipping stone leaping over another stone with an arcing ink trajectory

name: FLANK
rules: Move one friendly piece 1 square diagonally. The destination must be empty or contain an enemy. Eliminate that enemy if present.
artSubject: an angled arrow crossing a diagonal slash of ink, scattered bamboo leaves

name: TRANSPOSITION
rules: Swap one friendly piece with one enemy within distance 2. Neither piece is eliminated.
artSubject: a black and an ivory stone exchanging positions through an interlocking yin-yang shaped current, no faces

name: GUST
rules: Move up to 2 enemies 1 square each in the same horizontal or vertical direction. Both destinations must be empty before the skill.
artSubject: a paper folding fan releasing a sweeping gust that carries two dark stones, no hand

name: RALLY
rules: Choose a friendly anchor. Move up to 2 other friendly pieces 1 square each horizontally or vertically toward it. Each move must reduce distance and land empty.
artSubject: three pale river stones converging beneath a tall fluttering banner, no people

name: SCATTER
rules: Move up to 2 different friendly pieces 1 square diagonally each. Both destinations must be empty before the skill.
artSubject: two maple leaves flying apart in opposite diagonal directions across an ink burst

name: CROSSFIRE
rules: Eliminate an enemy between two friendly pieces in one row or column. Each ally must be within distance 3 with no pieces between it and the target.
artSubject: two arrows converging from opposite sides on a dark suspended leaf, no people

name: CHAIN STRIKE
rules: Choose a friendly piece. Eliminate an adjacent enemy, then optionally 1 enemy adjacent to the first target. Adjacency is horizontal or vertical.
artSubject: two connected forks of lightning striking two dark stones, no people

name: MANA SURGE
rules: Gain 2 mana, up to the mana cap. This uses your skill for the turn.
artSubject: a luminous muted gold pearl floating inside an ink enso with rising mist

name: REFOCUS
rules: Return both movement cards to the movement deck. Shuffle, then draw 2 movement cards.
artSubject: two parchment talismans circling an empty ink enso, abstract unlettered marks

name: FORESIGHT
rules: Look at the top 3 skill cards, or all remaining cards if fewer. Return them to the top in any order before drawing your replacement.
artSubject: three blank parchment slips floating above rippling water, a faint reflection of the moon

name: BANISH
rules: Choose a friendly piece. Send an adjacent enemy to an empty square on that enemy's starting row. Adjacency is horizontal or vertical.
artSubject: a dark stone swept through an empty distant temple gate by a spiral of mist
